milestones.label: Full paper submission deadline
milestones.note: Full papers are limited to 5 pages.

milestones.label: Re-submission deadline
milestones.note: Applies to papers invited to re-submit after the initial decision.

milestones.label: Mandatory author registration
milestones.note: At least one author of each accepted full paper must be fully registered; each accepted submission requires a separate registration.

milestones.label: MIE 2027 conference
milestones.note: Conference runs 26–30 April 2027 in Tallinn, Estonia.

slots.label: Paper preparation
slots.note: Prepare the 5-page full paper in English according to the IOS Press formatting guidelines.

slots.label: Review and revision after initial decision
slots.note: Use this period for revisions if the initial decision invites re-submission.

slots.label: Acceptance and registration
slots.note: Complete mandatory author registration by 24 February 2027 if accepted.

slots.label: Conference preparation
slots.note: Prepare the oral presentation. Full-paper presentations are scheduled for approximately 8 minutes plus 2 minutes for questions.

processes.label: Preparing full paper submission
processes.note: Full papers are original research contributions for publication in the indexed conference proceedings.
